label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameter flows through doSomething() where Base64 encode/decode operations preserve the original content (no effective sanitization), resulting in 'bar' containing user-controlled data. This becomes the filename via new java.io.File(bar) at line 48, creating path traversal vulnerability. Additionally, the HTML-encoded file path is concatenated into response output at lines 51-57, creating XSS vulnerability. Both paths are reachable and exploitable.

evidence.note: User input param from getParameter flows through doSomething() where Base64 encode/decode preserves content, becoming filename bar
new java.io.File(bar) uses user-controlled string as filename, enabling path traversal
HTML-encoded file path concatenated into response output creates XSS vulnerability
